info.title: Tetrac Trading API
info.description:
Multi-exchange trading data API — tickers, funding rates, open interest,
technical analysis (Tetrac scanner), news, economic calendar, market
intelligence, volume data, and order execution across 30+ CEXs and DEXs.

## Authentication

Every endpoint except the free `/api/v1/markets` discovery index requires one of:

- **Session auth** — pass `ttc-auth-token` (Bearer) + `ttc-public-key` header for registered Tetrac users.
- **x402 micropayment** — pass a signed Solana USDC payment ($0.05 standard, $0.50 for the full-market scanner snapshot) in the `x-x402-payment` header.
  See [x402.json](https://www.tetrac.xyz/.well-known/x402.json) for payment details.

Responses from paid endpoints include an `x-x402-receipt` header confirming payment.

get.description: Free discovery index for every `/api/v1/markets/*` endpoint — no payment and no session required. Returns `{pricing, methods}`: `pricing` is the standard per-request price of the listed endpoints `{amount, currency, network, per}`, and `methods` is keyed by sub-route slug (e.g. `funding-rates`) with `{name, path, method, description, price: {amount, currency}, params}` per entry, so an agent can see what each paid endpoint costs before paying for any of them. Rate-limited per client (per account when a session is presented); over the limit it returns 429 with `Retry-After`. (Free)

method.description: HTTP method, or an array when the endpoint accepts several

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.description: Returns an array of unified ticker objects (`symbol`, `price`, `change24h`, `volume24hUSD`, `bid`, `ask`, `exchange`) covering spot and perpetual pairs across 30+ CEXs and DEXs, served from a single hybrid cache. Use this to screen markets in one paid call instead of fanning out per-exchange. Query params filter the result set: `type` (spot|futures), `exchange`, `symbol`, `minimumVolume`, `minimumPrice`, `maximumPrice`, `up` (gainers ≥ X%), `down` (losers ≥ X%). ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: Filter markets up by at least X%

parameters.name: down
parameters.description: Filter markets down by at least X%

get.description:
Returns an array of perpetual-futures funding entries (`exchange`, `symbol`, `fundingRate`, `intervalHours`, `hourlyRate`, `dailyRoi`, `nextFundingTime`) live across major perp venues. Use to spot funding-rate arbitrage between venues, monitor extreme rates that signal crowded positioning, or rank perps by funding cost. Filter by `symbol`. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

**Comparing venues:** `fundingRate` is each venue's NATIVE per-interval rate, and that interval differs per MARKET — not merely per exchange. A single venue commonly runs 1h, 4h and 8h markets side by side, so raw `fundingRate` values are not comparable across rows. Use `hourlyRate` (rate normalized to a 1-hour basis) for any cross-venue comparison, and `dailyRoi` (`hourlyRate` x 24) for a rough 24h projection.

`hourlyRate` and `dailyRoi` are **omitted** when the market's settlement interval could not be established, rather than being estimated from a default. Check `intervalSource` to distinguish a confirmed interval from an unknown one.

Returns the latest open-interest snapshot for Binance crypto perpetuals — array of `{symbol, openInterest, openInterestValue (USD)}` plus a `marketsCount` and `timestamp`. Use to detect OI build-up that often precedes price moves and spot liquidation cascades. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

Returns the latest "new listings" delta — `{data: {newListings: ProcessedTickerData[], totalCount, previousCount}, timestamp, cached}`. Pulls the live spot+perp ticker set from the hybrid market cache, diffs it against a rolling 24h known-symbols set, and returns the tokens that newly appeared. Server caches the result for 1h so concurrent agents see a stable answer; the rolling known-set then advances and the next GET produces the next delta. POST exists for clients with their own ticker source (submit `{ tickers: ProcessedTickerData[] }` to diff against the same known set). ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

previousCount.description: Size of the known-symbols set before this snapshot

timestamp.description: Epoch ms when the snapshot was computed

cached.description: True if served from the 1h snapshot cache, false on fresh compute

get.description: Returns an array of `{exchange, volume24h (USD), pairCount}` plus a snapshot `timestamp` for cross-exchange 24-hour volume comparison. Use to rank exchanges by liquidity, detect volume migration between venues, or feed market-share dashboards. Filter by `exchange`. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

Returns historical daily DEX swap volume — an array of `{date, totalVolume (USD), perChainVolumes}` entries. Use to track on-chain trading activity over time and identify chains gaining DEX share. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

Returns which venues list each symbol: `data.symbolVenues` maps an upper-cased symbol to the sorted venue ids that offer a market for it. This is a listings index (does a venue offer the market), not a price aggregate — use it to find where a symbol trades before calling a venue-specific endpoint. Rebuilt at most once every 24 hours; `data.updatedAt` is the build time (epoch ms), `data.venueCount` the number of venues that contributed at least one symbol, and `cached` whether the call was served from that cache. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

Runs a multi-timeframe Quadrant-lines technical scan for one symbol. Returns `{price, scans (per-timeframe scan results), scoring (bull/bear strength), signal: {direction (LONG|SHORT|NEUTRAL), strength, confidence (HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW), entry, stoploss, takeProfits[]}}`. Use as a one-call signal generator for a specific symbol/timeframe — entry, stop, and up to three TPs derived from the same fan structure. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

Returns the latest CACHED technical-analysis signals for every scanned market in one call (no params). Each entry carries the same `signal` payload as the per-symbol scanner. Use as a one-call market-wide signal feed; the snapshot refreshes at most hourly. ($0.50 USDC on Solana mainnet)

200.description: Full cached snapshot of per-market signals

staleAtMs.description: Epoch ms when the snapshot becomes eligible for a refresh, or null if none exists yet

get.description: Returns a market-impact news feed — array of `{title, summary, source, url, publishedAt, sentiment, marketImpact}` entries aggregated from major crypto and macro outlets. Use to detect market-moving headlines or as feature input for sentiment-aware strategies. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

Vector-similarity ticker search plus an LLM-generated market analysis for the given query.
Returns:
  - `insights` — natural-language analysis (`summary`, `analysis`, or `report` depending on `type`).
  - `tickers` — up to `limit` Binance spot pairs (volume ≥ $1M) ranked by semantic similarity to `query`,
    each enriched with the live ticker fields plus a one-line `description`.
($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

tickers.description: Ranked similar tickers (Binance spot, volume ≥ $1M) with a one-line description

get.description: Returns a filtered economic calendar — `{events: [{title, date, country, impact (high|medium|low), source, ...}], fromCache}`. Covers macro releases that move crypto (FOMC, CPI prints, NFP, ECB) plus crypto-specific events. Use to schedule strategy windows around high-impact macro events or pause trading bots ahead of releases. Filter by `impact` and `country`. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

Returns a GeoJSON `FeatureCollection` of "market quake" events — sudden abnormal volume + price spikes detected across exchanges. Each feature carries `{symbol, exchange, magnitude, type (spike|dump), timestamp, geometry}`. Use as a real-time alert stream for unusual market activity. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

Open-interest snapshot across Solana perpetual venues, collected server-side in one pass. `rows` holds venues that publish a genuine long-vs-short split (`{venue, symbol, longUsd, shortUsd, longPositions, shortPositions}` — the position counts are `null` when a venue publishes none); `totals` holds venues that publish combined open interest only (`{venue, symbol, totalUsd}`); `venueStatus` maps each venue id to `ok` or `error`, so a degraded source is visible instead of silently missing. `fetchedAt` is the ISO collection time. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: venues
parameters.description: Comma-separated venue ids (case-insensitive) that `rows` and `totals` are narrowed to. Omit for every venue; the valid ids are the keys of `venueStatus`.

200.description: Long/short and total open-interest rows per venue and symbol

get.description: Returns the top Pacifica trader accounts ranked by current open-interest notional, trimmed to `{address, label, oiUsd}` each, plus `totalRanked` (accounts on the upstream leaderboard) and `fetchedAt`. `label` is `null` when the trader has enabled privacy mode. Built for subscribing to those accounts on Pacifica's public WebSocket — this endpoint is address discovery only and carries no trade events itself. Refreshed at most every 5 minutes. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of accounts to return. Values above the maximum are capped; a non-positive or non-numeric value falls back to the default.

get.summary: Exchange read — positions, balances, orders, bid-ask
get.description:
Read-only exchange dispatcher — one endpoint that proxies read calls to any supported venue. Pass `method` plus the target `exchange`; for account-data methods, also pass `apiKey`/`apiSecret`/`passphrase` as query params.

Supported methods (response shape varies by method):
  - `getTickers` — array of live ticker objects for the venue
  - `getBestBidAsk` — best bid/ask for a `symbol`
  - `getPositions` — open positions for the credentialed account
  - `getBalance` — account balance summary
  - `getOrders` — open or historical orders
  - `getUserTradeHistory` — fills

Returns `{success, data: <method-shaped>, exchange, code}`. Use to query any supported exchange through one unified endpoint instead of integrating each venue's SDK. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

schema.description: Venue roster changes over time and is not enumerated here; the current list is returned by `GET /api/v1/exchanges` (including in its 402 discovery response, which requires no payment) and is shown on https://www.tetrac.xyz.

post.summary: Exchange trade — place/cancel orders, set leverage, close positions
post.description:
Trading dispatcher — one endpoint that executes order/position actions on any supported venue. Body fields: `exchangeName`, `method`, `params` (method-specific), `credentials` (`apiKey`/`apiSecret`/`passphrase`).

**IMPORTANT**: Executes REAL trades with REAL money. Always confirm parameters with the user before calling.

Supported methods (`params` shape varies by method):
  - `placeMarketOrder` — `{symbol, side, quantity, reduceOnly?}`
  - `placeLimitOrder` — `{symbol, side, quantity, price, timeInForce?, reduceOnly?}`
  - `placeStopOrder` — `{symbol, side, quantity, stopPrice, ...}`
  - `cancelOrder` — `{symbol, orderId}`
  - `cancelAllOrders` — `{symbol?}`
  - `closeAllPositions` — `{}`
  - `setLeverage` — `{symbol, leverage}`
  - `setHedgeMode` — `{enabled}`

Returns `{success, data: <method-shaped result>, exchange, code}`. Use to execute trades on any supported venue without integrating each SDK. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

exchangeName.description: Venue roster changes over time and is not enumerated here; the current list is returned by `GET /api/v1/exchanges` (including in its 402 discovery response, which requires no payment) and is shown on https://www.tetrac.xyz.

params.description: Method-specific parameters (symbol, side, quantity, price, leverage, etc.)

get.description: Probes every configured venue from Tetrac's servers and returns two independent measurements per exchange: a TLS-handshake time (`tlsLatency`/`tlsStatus`) and a full data-endpoint roundtrip (`dataLatency`/`dataStatus`), plus the resolved `hostname`, `ip`, hosting `org` and static `tickerCount`. Takes no parameters — every configured venue is probed on each call. Rows are sorted data-online first, then by ascending data latency. Use to pick the lowest-latency venue for execution, or to detect a venue whose API is degraded while its edge is still up. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

200.description: Per-exchange latency probe results plus aggregate summary

summary.description: Aggregate counts and mean latency, split per probe type

timestamp.description: Epoch ms when the probe run completed

fundingRate.description: The venue's NATIVE rate for one settlement interval, as a decimal fraction (0.0001 = 0.01%). NOT comparable across rows — see hourlyRate.

intervalHours.description: This market's settlement interval in hours. Omitted when it could not be established.

intervalSource.description: How intervalHours was determined. "unknown" means the rate is un-normalized and hourlyRate/dailyRoi are absent.

hourlyRate.description: fundingRate normalized to a 1-hour basis. The cross-venue comparable. Omitted when intervalHours is unknown.

dailyRoi.description: hourlyRate x 24 — a hypothetical 24h projection, not compounded. Omitted when hourlyRate is.

nextFundingTime.description: Epoch milliseconds of the next settlement.

LatencyProbeSummary.description: Aggregate result for one probe type (TLS handshake or data endpoint) across every exchange in the run.

averageLatency.description: Mean latency in ms over the probes that succeeded. Failed probes (latency -1) are excluded, and the value is 0 when none succeeded.

hostname.description: Host of the venue's data endpoint, which is also the TLS probe target

ip.description: IPv4 resolved for hostname, or null when DNS lookup failed

tlsLatency.description: TLS-handshake time in ms, or -1 when the probe failed or timed out

tlsStatus.description: "online" = handshake completed, "timeout" = socket timeout, "offline" = TCP/TLS error.

dataLatency.description: Data-endpoint roundtrip in ms, or -1 when the probe failed or timed out

dataStatus.description: "online" = HTTP 2xx or 400 (some APIs 400 a bare GET), "timeout" = aborted at the probe deadline, "offline" = network error or other non-2xx.

lastChecked.description: Epoch ms at which both probes for this exchange finished

tickerCount.description: Static per-venue market count from configuration, not measured

org.description: Hosting org / ASN resolved from the IP, or a hostname-derived fallback

AuthToken.name: ttc-auth-token
AuthToken.description: Session token from Tetrac login (24-hour expiry)

PublicKey.name: ttc-public-key
PublicKey.description: Solana public key associated with the session token

X402Payment.name: x-x402-payment
X402Payment.description: Signed Solana USDC micropayment ($0.05 standard, $0.50 for the full-market scanner snapshot) — alternative to session auth
